name: Kuruse Minami
source:
"Because you're always doing something weird, I have to keep an eye on you!"

High school 1st-year.

Hokuto's childhood friend from kindergarten. When she entered high school, she wasn't very interested in the light music club, but got caught up with Hokuto and ended up joining it anyways. She is actually the daughter of the best doctor in town.

[Translated from [url=https://d10rama.com/nitousei/]official website[/url]]
